description: Source visual cortical area of the reported pathway.
value_coding: macaque visual-area abbreviations (32 areas, matching Table 3's column set plus row-only PIT/CIT/STP groups)

description: Target visual cortical area of the reported pathway.
Laminar origin of the pathway as reported by studies of the SOURCE area's efferents ('Outputs' side of the table).
value_coding: S=supragranular, B=bilaminar, I=infragranular, S/B or I/B=reported as either, NA=not reported

description: Laminar pattern of termination, Outputs side.
value_coding: F=layer-4 predominant, C=columnar, M=multilayer avoiding layer 4, combinations (e.g. F/C) and NA as above
A=ascending, L=lateral, D=descending, 'u'=pathway demonstrated but laminar features (hence direction) unknown, '?' suffix=uncertain, NA=not reported

description: Laminar origin as reported by studies of the TARGET area's afferents ('Inputs' side).
Laminar pattern of termination, Inputs side.
Hierarchical relationship assigned to the (from_area,to_area) pair.
value_coding: A-D=ascending-descending pair consistent with a hierarchy (laminar patterns in both directions agree); NR/NR?=non-reciprocal (or uncertain-non-reciprocal) pathway; NC/NC?=not classifiable (or uncertain) given conflicting laminar evidence

description: Number of hierarchical levels this pathway traverses in the paper's Figure 4 hierarchy diagram, when the pair's hierarchical relationship is known.
